newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-NECK INJURY SIDELINES MERCER, GOLOTA SEEKS NEW OPPONENT.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-NECK INJURY SIDELINES MERCER, GOLOTA SEEKS NEW OPPONENT.

text.p: Heavyweight contender Ray Mercer has suffered a neck injury that rules him out of his August 16 bout against Andrew Golota, promoter Dino Duva announced on Friday.
A statement issued by Duva quoted New York University spinal surgeon Dr Thomas Errico as saying Mercer suffered from "multi-level cervical disc herniations with cord compressions and flattening."
Duva said Golota would fight on the Atlantic City card in any event and that "we will work feverishly to sign a challenging opponent for Andrew Golota."
"I will fight anyone they put in front of me," Golota said in the statement. "It makes no difference to me who I knock out. I just want to fight and put myself in a position for a title shot."
